TIDY-TOOL(1)                    User Commands                     TIDY-TOOL(1)

NAME
       tidy-tool — Tidies files.

DESCRIPTION
       A tool that tidies files.

       Lua · Penlight · LPeg

       repository   https://github.test/mira/tidy-tool

       author    Mira Example <https://example.test/index.txt>
       status    done
       install   go install example.test/tidy-tool@latest

       $ tidy .
       tidied 3 files

WHY
       Files were untidy.

example.test                                                      TIDY-TOOL(1)
